# Planninq

> Kanban-based project and task management for Nextcloud dev and IT teams: projects, tasks, boards with WIP limits, backlogs and time entries. Built as a thin client on OpenRegister.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test, lint and repo conventions for coding agents
- [README.md](README.md): overview, features and development
- [project.md](project.md): architecture, tech stack and key files
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution workflow and commit format

## Docs

- [docs/intro.md](docs/intro.md): introduction to the user documentation
- [docs/Installation/demo-environment.md](docs/Installation/demo-environment.md): local demo environment
- [docs/features/](docs/features/): one page per feature (board, projects, tasks, time tracking and more)
- [docs/tutorials/](docs/tutorials/): user and admin tutorials
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): standards research and data model decisions
- [docs/FEATURES.md](docs/FEATURES.md): competitive analysis and feature roadmap

## API

- [openapi.json](openapi.json): OpenAPI document for the app's HTTP API

## Specs and decisions

- [openspec/specs/](openspec/specs/): current capability specs
- [openspec/changes/](openspec/changes/): open changes; finished ones in `openspec/changes/archive/`
- [openspec/architecture/](openspec/architecture/): architecture decision records
- [openspec/config.yaml](openspec/config.yaml): project context and spec rules

## Configuration

- [lib/Settings/planninq_register.json](lib/Settings/planninq_register.json): OpenRegister register and schemas
- [src/manifest.json](src/manifest.json): frontend page manifest
